tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when the answer needs current or sourced information from the web: news, papers, people, posts on X, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, Reddit and Hacker News discussions, patents, places, images or general queries. social: posts and videos with views, likes, comments and authors in metadata; n

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this to read one public web page as markdown, by a search result's `id` or any http(s) URL. Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}; up to 40,000 characters a call, and a longer page continues with `offset` = metadata.next_offset, served from the page just read and not charged again. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: fetch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: fetch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
